definition: to break down or fall apart
description: A misty beach at dawn, with dark pine trees on the shore and driftwood and seaweed on the wet sand. A figure has been built out of balanced grey and green beach stones: two stone legs, a rounded stone body, outstretched stone arms and a small stone head, standing on the wet sand with its reflection under it. It stands still for several seconds. Then one arm drops away, the head tips off, and the whole stack falls in on itself until nothing is left but a low heap of pebbles lying in the shallow water with the same trees and fog behind.

en.question: What is happening to the stone figure?
